mapper.insert: insert into t_signed_prekey (username, device_id, pre_key_id, public_key, signature, crt_time, upd_time) values (#{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{preKeyId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{publicKey,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{signature,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{crtTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}) on duplicate key update pre_key_id = values(pre_key_id), public_key = values(public_key), signature = values(signature), upd_time = values(upd_time)

insert ignore into t_one_time_prekey (username, device_id, pre_key_id, public_key, crt_time) values (#{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{preKeyId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{publicKey,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{crtTime,jdbcType=BIGINT})

insert ignore into t_one_time_prekey (username, device_id, pre_key_id, public_key, crt_time) values
(#{item.username,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.preKeyId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.publicKey,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{item.crtTime,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: select id, username, device_id, pre_key_id, public_key, crt_time, claimed_by, claimed_at from t_one_time_prekey where username = #{username,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and device_id = #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and claimed_by is null order by id asc limit 1 for update
